root_cause_analysis.symptom: Inline CronList card collapses to a single header row showing only 'CronList'; no input/argument summary row is rendered.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: knownTools.tsx CronList entry defines extractDescription (which is consumed only by TaskView.tsx for subagent rendering) but does NOT define extractSubtitle. ToolView.tsx — the generic renderer that handles CronList — reads ONLY extractSubtitle (extractStrings(): line 161-164) for the second-row description. Therefore the description function on CronList is silently dead, and the second-row JSX (ToolView.tsx:93-97 'cfg.description && <Text>') never renders because cfg.description is null.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A — present since Cycle 4 of spec-20260424-084848 introduced minimal:true + extractDescription on CronList (no git bisect needed; the field-name mismatch is visible in the current source).
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Cycle 4's 'simplify the inline card' direction made minimal:true the goal and used extractDescription as the description-source field. extractDescription is consumed by TaskView (Agent/Task) for subagent rendering, not by the generic ToolView path that CronList travels.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: User's verbatim direction was '展示 input 就行' (show the input — keep it minimal but DO show it), not 'remove the input'. Cycle 4 deleted the input row instead of compacting it.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Cycle 4 (~2026-04-24/25) introduced the over-simplified state. QA Cycle 5 reported PASS on the over-simplified state. User audit 2026-04-25 ~14:50–15:00 reversed the verdict to FAIL.
observations: CronList card outerHTML at https://dev.life-ai.app/session/cmoedofgz86n5nz15xsldnk35 contains exactly one text node 'CronList' with no second-row Text sibling — observed via Playwright DOM read 2026-04-25T20:21Z (desktop 1440x900 AND mobile 390x844).
Adjacent Bash card on the same conversation shows two rows: header 'Inspect attached binary file' + body '$ ls -la /tmp/happy-attachments/...' — observed via Playwright DOM read 2026-04-25T20:21Z.
ToolView.tsx:161-164 (inferred from source): extractStrings() reads only knownTool.extractSubtitle for the description, NOT extractDescription.
knownTools.tsx:952-967 (inferred from source): CronList entry has extractDescription but no extractSubtitle.

Mobile viewport screenshot side-by-side proof: docs/dev/evidence/ba-20260425-201355-5-18/cronlist-mobile-390.jpeg — top card 'CronList' (single row), card immediately below shows Bash 'List dev spec files and confirm' + '$ ls /root/docs/dev/...' (two rows).

pre_existing_guards.purpose: Only render the second-row Text if a description string is present. This guard is GOOD — it prevents an empty Text node when no subtitle exists. The fix does not need to remove or weaken this guard; it just needs to ensure cfg.description is non-empty for CronList by populating extractSubtitle.

pre_existing_guards.code_snippet: if (knownTool && typeof knownTool.extractSubtitle === 'function') { const sub = knownTool.extractSubtitle({ tool, metadata }); if (typeof sub === 'string' && sub) description = sub; }
pre_existing_guards.purpose: Type-checks that extractSubtitle is callable and returns a non-empty string. The fix MUST return a non-empty string from extractSubtitle (e.g. '{}' literal) — empty string would be filtered out by this guard.
Zod schema declaring CronList accepts any object input (zero or more keys). Confirms the tool may legitimately be called with {} — supports the 'render even when {}' requirement.

novelty_check.rationale: Cycle 4 was subtractive at L2 (delete the second row by routing through a field name the renderer ignores). This attempt is additive at L2/L3: define extractSubtitle (the field the renderer actually reads) and populate it with a non-empty input summary, modeled on Bash's commandLine row. The fix reverses Cycle 4's direction (add row instead of remove) and uses a different field name (extractSubtitle instead of extractDescription).
